label: vBucket
type: one of the 1024 hash partitions into which a bucket's key space is divided; the unit of data distribution and failover across nodes.
note:
The mechanism underneath every distribution claim in the corpus, promoted with its two states. 1024 is a fixed cardinality the docs state as a constant rather than a tunable - noted here because a reader coming from other sharded systems will look for the knob.

FOLDS A CROSS-ROUND DUPLICATE, and one this project predicted and then walked into anyway. Round 11 minted `data:vbucket` at recurrence 1 from search-service.json - 'the unit DCP streams' - and its own note said the term was 'certain to' recur. It did, in the very next round, from the buckets-memory-and-storage batch, under a different namespace, because nothing connects a prediction written in a reconciliation log to the id an agent picks eleven pages later. Combined recurrence 3. This is the known near-duplicate-across-rounds failure mode, and it was caught by `verify-promotions.py` rather than by anyone noticing: round 12's own prose named `data:vbucket` while promoting `server:vbucket`, and the tool flagged the id with no file. The general lesson is the round's own: a prediction in prose is a hope, an alias in a record is a control - so the fold is recorded here rather than left as a note that the two terms are probably the same.
